subject: Re: Status: FNet GLUE dry runs + eval harness quirk
body:
Team — decisions from this morning's checkpoint.

The June pre-train completed within the reserved window, so we're committing to the launch-review slot on Jun 18 with Nadia's board. Scope decision: we present the low-cost encoder tier on the full GLUE matrix minus WNLI (tiny, noisy, not worth a slide). Nikhil's final numbers land Jun 15; Kaia writes the model card from the C4 pre-training config.

On serving, Zeke's team will host the demo endpoint on Shipyard staging — Jorge, please hand them the checkpoint by Jun 12.

Known risk we disclose at review: the quality gap versus the attention baseline is real, about 2-3 GLUE points. Our pitch is cost, not parity.

Nice work getting the pre-train through cleanly.

Dmitri
